scanNotes: 2026-10-23: Searched upcoming entertainment through 22 December, with Indian artist and festival searches extending to February 2027. Partial coverage only.

Rechecked 14 retained records: Am Himmel, City Jam, Glow, Karawoke, eight Charlie P’s listings, the October American Improv show and UTSAV. Added nine listings: Prater Halloween, November/December American Improv, three mdw concerts and three Wintermarkt concerts. Exact dates were individually published; no recurring dates inferred.

Removed completed Alles im Fluss, Siebenbrunnen pumpkin festival and Funny Bone records, plus the completed 22 October karaoke occurrence (ended 01:30 on 23 October). Stable IDs retained for future occurrences.

The MQ winter-programme URL returned 404 on detailed fetch and retry. Its five retained records keep their 22 October checked dates. Five future Comedy Pub detail pages and the directory were inaccessible; their checked dates remain unchanged.

Eventbrite rate-limited the Bhajan Clubbing booking page. Imperial brunch booking returned no usable contents. Prices and booking conditions could not be confirmed; neither event was added. TU Wien Diwali has its programme under construction and no usable admission confirmation.

The Viennale matinee is advertised with German subtitles. LUX Film Days has inconsistent year/day information (2025 publication and weekdays under a 2026 title); no screenings were added. Theatre, fireworks and nearby discovery did not produce additional fully verified suitable entries.

November American Improv links to external booking; live places were not verified. December displays a waiting-list notice and an external booking link, both disclosed. October still displays a waiting list despite the organiser directory saying few tickets.

mdw’s early-music event page gives an inconsistent 1010 postcode for Joseph Haydn-Saal; the university’s main calendar confirms Anton-von-Webern-Platz 1, 1030 Wien. The campus address uses the corroborated postcode.
